title: Workbench v2: Rocket → Scenario → Run
brief: Redesign of the icaro Workbench for university rocketry teams so the web, the API contract and the core tell one story: a Rocket (OpenRocket files), a Scenario edited in the Workbench, and Runs listed in the logbook with a permanent report. Tokens from design/system.md, both palettes.

artboards.title: Workbench · file loaded, no run yet
artboards.tradeoff: The results column shows the rocket itself (S3) instead of an empty placeholder; rail defaults come from the .ork with per-field Overridden/Reset (S4); no Uncertainty section (S5)

artboards.title: Workbench · after a run
artboards.tradeoff: One long results column (warnings → replay → KPIs → OpenRocket row → series → timeline → disclosures) shared with the report; stale state lives in the top bar with change chips, not in the results

artboards.title: Rocket panel (plus legacy-file variant)
artboards.tradeoff: One popover owns file switching, comparison and import once a file is active; the Workbench stays visible but inert behind a scrim

artboards.title: Runs logbook with compare overlay
artboards.tradeoff: Compare chart on top, full-width tables grouped by rocket with deltas against a baseline; every row reopens in the Workbench instead of re-running silently

artboards.title: Run report /results/{id}
artboards.tradeoff: Printout reuses the exact Workbench result composition, adds breadcrumb, header and Configuration; plots collapsed by default to keep the page short

artboards.title: Workbench on a phone · Result tab
artboards.tradeoff: Results first on phones; inputs behind a tab, sidebar becomes a bottom bar, stale shown as a dot plus chips under the tabs

artboards.title: Run report on a phone
artboards.tradeoff: Single column for shared links: full-width replay, KPIs 2×2, disclosures collapsed, Configuration stacked at the end
